title: Postern Consent Spine — the shared cross-tier consent state file (v1)
description: ONE contract spanning three tiers (Porog / NoporIS / Waydroid). Every tier's state file at /var/lib/postern/<product>-gate/state.json (0600, root-owned) shares an IDENTICAL spine (schema, version, tier, consent, killSwitch, lang) and differs ONLY in its capability object and one pinned tier rail. A reader MUST treat a missing/unparseable file, a foreign `schema`, an unknown `version`, or any missing field as full-deny + not-consented. EVERY capability defaults to DENY. Nothing here is telemetry; the file never leaves the device. Reference-prototype, UNAUDITED — certifies nothing. The coin is not a security; personal use is free; not legal advice.

consent.description: First-entry consent. Default DENY: not entered unless accepted on purpose after reading the honest disclosure.

accepted.description: True only after the operator read the honest disclosure and accepted. Default DENY.

scope.description: 'session' = valid this boot only (re-ask next boot); 'persistent' = remembered until revoked. Safer default = session.

acceptedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of acceptance, or null. Local record only.

killSwitch.description: Operator kill-switch. Engaging is always allowed, drops the span, and NEVER destroys the sealed wallet/keys. Default not-engaged so a fresh file does not wedge a legitimately-enabled container; entry still requires consent.accepted.

engaged.description: True = span down, reader must refuse entry until disengaged. Default DENY-of-entry via consent, not via kill.

engagedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp last engaged, or null.

lang.description: Last UI language. Cosmetic; the reader may ignore it.

crossing.description: One per-capability crossing (NoporIS shape). DENY by default; open only by an explicit, disclosed, individually-revocable toggle. Any value that is not exactly true is never-given. `direction` pins the single authorised lane (its own vocabulary, distinct from Porog's).

open.description: True = lent across right now. Default DENY.

direction.description: The single authorised lane: 'near-to-far' (clean side hands to the Google-Play side, the safer default) or 'far-to-near' (the more dangerous ingest lane, chosen on purpose). Never 'both'; missing/unknown collapses to 'near-to-far'.

openedAtIso.description: ISO-8601 timestamp opened, or null when closed.

crossingDirectional.description: One per-capability cross-profile crossing (Porog shape). DENY by default. `direction` is first-class: a crossing open without a real direction installs NO grant (fail-closed). `package` (calendar/connectedApp only) names the single allowlisted package.

direction.description: 'p2w' personal->Google, 'w2p' Google->personal, 'both', or 'none' (closed). Not one of these => 'none'.

package.description: Exactly one allowlisted package (standing/ambient crossings only), or null.

egress.description: Waydroid tier rail: egress is ALWAYS Tor-only. torOnly is fixed true (never from input) so no file can downgrade to a clearnet path; torBootstrapped is the live 'is Tor up' signal — until true, egress is DENIED (fail-closed). Tor here is CLIENT-ONLY metadata reduction, NOT anonymity.

torOnly.description: Fixed true. No supported clearnet path for the container.

torBootstrapped.description: True ONLY while postern-tor reports a usable circuit. Default false = no egress.

sealedWallet.description: NoporIS/Porog tier rail: cutting the bridge must never destroy the sealed wallet/keys on the near side. 'preserved' is fixed true (never from input, never cleared by the kill-switch).

preserved.description: Fixed true. The sealed wallet is never destroyed by the bridge, its crossings, or the kill-switch.

slobodaState.description: Waydroid tier — 'Postern for postmarketOS, community edition'. NON-ATTESTABLE (not covered by the Postern Seal). Capability object is the flat-bool `bridges`; tier rail is `egress` (Tor-only).

schema.description: Discriminator; a reader refuses a foreign file outright.

tier.description: PINNED. Never relabelled as attested; not covered by os_roothash / the Seal.

bridges.description: Per-capability host<->container bridges (flat bool). Each defaults to DENY; only ever true by an explicit, disclosed toggle.

noporisState.description: NoporIS tier — guarded bridge to a far Google-Play persona. NON-ATTESTABLE (the far side is the LESS-PRIVATE side; phones home to Google; no Tor rail). Capability object is `crossings` ({open,scope,openedAtIso}); tier rail is `sealedWallet`.

tier.description: PINNED. The far side is never attested; no Seal, no measured boot.

porogState.description: Porog tier — stock-Android managed-profile cross-profile door. KEY-ATTESTED-DEVICE: attests the PHONE, NOT the workspace (never measured-boot). Capability object is directional `crossings`; tier rail is `sealedWallet`.

tier.description: PINNED. Key-attested DEVICE only; never 'attested workspace' / 'measured-boot'.

crossings.description: user-mediated (intents/clipboard/files) + standing/ambient (contacts/calendar/connectedApp — hard-deny, separate stronger consent). Each defaults DENY.
